body:
Filing gate: ① an open PR on main's dependency surface that is red, with each failure named. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) during the maintainer-requested sweep of PRs older than 6 hours (2026-10-28 00:30Z), with the maintainer's approval to file it. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (check-runs on head `b5723e46`, committed 2026-10-27T17:06Z)

The PR bumps 22 development dependencies (`@types/node`, `@typescript-eslint/*`, `vite-plugin-dts`, `react-router-dom` and others). Four `Test UI` shards and `Check Changeset` are red:

| Shard | Failing test | What it says |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 14/16 | `ui/packages/create-plugin/src/__tests__/templates.test.ts:428` | `vite-plugin-dts: ^5.0.3 must match its in-repo plugin range, ^5.1.2` |
| 10/16 | `ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts:673` | `routed manifest's react-router-dom: ^7.18.2 must match the repo root, ^7.18.4` |
| 15/16 | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx:416` | `Unable to find an element with the text: os_13010_quote row 0` |
| 4/16 | `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/dialog-popover-focus-scope.test.tsx:95` | focus lands on the dialog's `<button>`, not the `search records` `<input>` |
| — | `Check Changeset` | this PR adds no changeset |

## Reading

- **Shards 14 and 10 are version pins doing their job.** The generator templates hardcode `vite-plugin-dts` and `react-router-dom` ranges, and a pin keeps them equal to the repo's own. The bump moves the repo ranges, so the template ranges must move in the same PR. This is mechanical.
- **Shards 15 and 4 are behaviour changes** under the bumped toolchain (render or focus timing). Each needs a root cause: either a test that leans on library timing, or a real regression from one bump. Find which bump with a bisect over the group, or by splitting the group.
- **Check Changeset:** dev-dependency bumps publish nothing, so this is `skip-changeset` if the diff touches no published package's runtime dependencies. Check that before labelling.

## Wanted

The PR goes green with every check as strict as it is now. ⛔ Never skip, retry-wrap or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never narrow a pin. Move the template ranges with the bump. Root-cause the two behaviour changes; if one bump causes one, that bump may be held out of the group, with a reason on the PR. Dependabot rebases itself, so a fix to the template ranges or tests lands on `main` (or on the Dependabot branch the way the repo's Dependabot process allows), not as a hand rebase.

## Reach

`main` is not affected. The PR is not merged, and its 22 bumps (some of them security patch releases in dev tooling) wait. Other seats already list #26556 as a serial constraint on `ui/package.json` (comments on #26717 and #26993).
